INFRARED SAUNA DOOR HARDWARE

Hello! Our main goal is to provide your best quality infrared sauna parts. Just complete the form and our specialist would contact you as soon as possible!

Some reasons to choose us!

  • Have you been struggling to find the right supplier that can consistently provide everything you need for your infrared sauna?
  • Or did you manage to find one before but your supplier has closed up shop?
  • Here’s how you’re able to get what you need from a company that has been in the business for a very long time.

InfraredSaunaParts is one of the leading infrared sauna parts suppliers in the country. We have been in business for more than 15 years and we’ve helped many sauna owners across the country to grow their business.

Unlike many other infrared sauna suppliers, we’re able to stay in business because we make sure that we’re ahead of our time in our products as well as in our service to our clients. There’s nothing InfraredSaunaParts value more than the relationship we have with our clients. In fact, we’re on first name basis with many of our clients!

In our 30,000 sq. ft facility, we’re able to house just about anything and everything that you need. Whether from accessories to LED lights, to door hardware and fittings to outdoor sauna covers; you name it, chances are we got it.

Even if when we don’t have something that you’re looking for, we make sure that we do our best to find it for you. We’ve seen enough sauna business went belly up that we hate to think it has to happen to any sauna owner. Due to this, we always update our catalogues and send emails to our existing clients about new arrivals.

All of our items are tested for wear and tear and they’re safety regulations compliant. The infrared sauna business can be hazardous if not careful. This is why we’re making sure our customers are not affected with any unwanted incidents or misfortune by being careful, meticulous, and strict about the safety and certifcation of our parts, accessories, and/or appliances.

If you’re looking to speak to someone about helping your infrared sauna business, why not pick up the phone and talk to us today? We’re sure we’re able to help you in any way you need!
